mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM campaign
AND delete_requested = FALSE
AND category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{category}, '%')
AND region LIKE CONCAT('%', #{region}, '%')
AND status = #{status}
AND ( title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR org_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO campaign (api_reg_no, org_name, title, description, purpose, goal_amount, current_amount, region, category, start_date, end_date, status, homepage_url, zip_code, address, tel_no, applied_at, owner_id, thumbnail_url) VALUES (CONCAT('사설-', REPLACE(UUID(), '-', '')), #{orgName}, #{title}, #{description}, #{purpose}, #{goalAmount}, 0, #{region}, #{category}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, IFNULL(#{status}, '모집예정'), #{homepageUrl}, #{zipCode}, #{address}, #{telNo}, #{appliedAt}, #{ownerId}, #{thumbnailUrl})
mapper.select: SELECT d.member_id AS memberId, c.campaign_id AS campaignId, c.title AS campaignTitle, SUM(d.amount) AS amount FROM donation d JOIN campaign c ON c.campaign_id = d.campaign_id WHERE c.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND c.status <> '사용완료' GROUP BY d.member_id, c.campaign_id, c.title
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM donation WHERE campaign_id IN (SELECT campaign_id FROM campaign WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId})
mapper.select: SELECT d.donation_id, CASE WHEN LENGTH(m.name) = 1 THEN m.name WHEN LENGTH(m.name) = 2 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(m.name, 1), '*') ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(m.name, 1), REPEAT('*', LENGTH(m.name) - 2), RIGHT(m.name, 1)) END AS masked_name, d.amount, d.donated_at FROM donation d JOIN member m ON d.member_id = m.member_id WHERE d.campaign_id = #{campaignId} ORDER BY d.donated_at DESC
SELECT campaign_id FROM campaign WHERE status = '모집중' AND end_date < CURDATE()
mapper.update: UPDATE campaign SET status = '모집완료' WHERE status = '모집중' AND end_date < CURDATE()
UPDATE campaign SET status = '모집중' WHERE status = '모집예정' AND start_date <= CURDATE()
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM campaign WHERE delete_requested = TRUE ORDER BY campaign_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM donation WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId}
